newsitem.title: USA: ARM Financial Q4 net income rises.
newsitem.headline: ARM Financial Q4 net income rises.

text.p: ARM Financial Group Inc said on Monday its 1996 fourth-quarter net income was $7.4 million, up from $6.9 million for the same period the year before.
Its 1996 full-year net income was $18.6 million, compared to $7.1 million in 1995.
Total sales were $2.7 billion in 1996, compared to $1.2 billion in 1995. For the fourth quarter of 1996, total sales were $858.8 million, compared to $379.4 million for the same period in 1995.
Per share data were not given.
The company attributed the increase in sales and net income in 1996 partly to its acquisition of SBM Co.
